title: doronicum austriacum subsp. giganteum
intro: Doronicum austriacum subsp. giganteum, commonly known as Giant Leopard's Bane, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Giant Leopard's Bane include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antispasmodic properties, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Doronicum austriacum subsp. giganteum include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
